To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The internationalisation process is a process of knowledge renewal and knowledge creation; The internationalisation process can be understood as a process of renewal of the knowledge base of the firm; The internationalisation of R&D can be understood as the internationalisation of knowledge creation and renewal.

(1) the process of internationalization is a process of knowledge creation, (2) the process of knowledge creation is a process of re-conversion of the knowledge assets, (3) the process of re-converting knowledge assets is a process of creating a new structure of the knowledge assets of the firm, and (4) the new structure of knowledge assets of the firms is a process of the creation of the new structure of power hierarchy of the firms.

the process of internationalization is a process conditioned to the renewal of knowledge, which can be done through R&D, and the process will be affected by control over knowledge, which will affect the hierarchy of the firm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the process of internationalising firms.
the process of international expansion of firms, and the process by which they renew their knowledge base, and the way that the power structure is affected by the process of knowledge management.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the process of Research & Development is an internationalisation strategy, and it is a way to create new assets, new knowledge and new products, which are not necessarily the same thing.

the internationalisation of the R&D process is a process of renewal, which takes place in the context of the firm, and is conditioned by the optimising process that takes into consideration new structures of the firm, the power hierarchy of it, and the control of knowledge.
the process of internationalization is a process that takes place in two dimensions, the internal and the external.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the internationalisation process of a firm, and the process by which a firm creates and renews knowledge are two different and complementary processes.
internationalisation and knowledge are two processes that are related and that are affected by the structure of the firm.
knowledge is the main asset that firms must protect, and the internationalisation process will be conditioned by the way firms manage the knowledge and the way they manage the process of RD.
The main takeaway from our work is that
knowledge is not an asset that can be managed in the same way as other assets, because it is a dynamic and complex asset.
the process of internationalization of firms is not only a process that takes into consideration market conditions, but also the internal process of the firms.
internationalisation strategies are not the same in every country.
